avis.titre: A cleaner, healthier feeling complexion is one masque away!
avis.texte: Not only does this dry faster than most masques I've used before, but it leaves a greaseless, silky-smooth complexion after just one use! Repeats results in clearer, smaller pores with a healthier glow to your skin! Straight forward and easy to apply, instructions right on the package with a good feeling when it's time for the masque to come off, it comes off in one clean sheet! A full peel, a great product that's straight-forward, don't let the small contained size fool you. One small drum can last a long time! Compact and perfect for anyone on the go, just apply (to a clean face as per directions) and let dry! Use once and you see instant results. But be warned: do NOT get it in your eyebrows or hairline. It's tough and gets deep in your pores, so it's unforgiving if it gets caught in your hair. A face detox can become a slow tweeze very quickly. Learn from my mistakes- avoid eyebrows and facial hair like the plague unless you're trying to join the Salty Spitoon.

avis.titre: It really does what it's meant for. I picked well.
avis.texte: I have never used a facial mask. I am 61 years old. It took me awhile to select a facial mask as I tend to do my research first before buying anything. laffs. The JVR peel off face mask is easy to use. The only downfall I experience is the instruction information is so tiny I could not read it. That said, I managed: Before you do anything, get some hand towel near your work space. Wash your face, place a hot towel or use a facial steamer to open your pores; 2. place a thin layer throughout your face or specific area, ( I did my entire face without touching my eyes or lips. Also the first time i used it i tried it with a thick layer then i tried it a week layer this a thin layer, yeap thin layer was perfect). 3. Wait til it completely drive. do not rush to take it off; leave till completely dries. 4. Once dried, then peel the thin layer off. You will find your skin clean, clear, and smooth. My skin did not come red, those i peeled it slowly and not ripped it off my face (I love myself too much, winks). So un stick the edges first then peel it off slowly. 5. any remaining JVR on face you can rinse it off with water. I personally prefer using Noxzema to wash my face and close my pores with gentle cool water. Then tap on my face with a dry towel. Face feels freshly clean. Allow your face to air breath before adding a night moisturizer. winks. Next time I do it i will take a little video let see if i can figure out the video technology. Results: yes it removed facial dirt, surface

I am rather enjoying this product. My skin feels great afterwards and a little goes a long way. Although it is a bit messy and application was finicky at first, the peel is satisfying and it does pull some gunk and peach fuzz out. While not as .. assertive as the nose strip thingies this is so much better. And it smells wonderful to boot. If you get it on something you shouldn't, such as a black handprint on your white tub, don't panic just let it dry first before you try to wipe it or it'll only get worse.

I’ve been using the JVR Peel Off Face Mask for blackheads and overall skin cleanup, and it works pretty well. The mask applies easily and dries within a reasonable amount of time. When peeling it off, it does a good job of pulling out dirt and some blackheads, especially around the nose and T-zone area. It leaves my skin feeling cleaner and smoother afterward. The charcoal formula has a fresh, clean feel and doesn’t irritate my skin. Just make sure to apply a thin, even layer so it dries properly and peels off in one piece. Overall, it’s a solid product for basic facial cleaning and maintenance.

Rating: 5.5/10 It was okay overall, but I was expecting a stronger peel-off mask. Even when I used a good amount of the product, it still stayed a little too soft and didn’t dry as much as I expected. It was easy enough to apply and remove, but I didn’t notice a huge difference with blackheads or deep cleansing. For the price it’s not terrible, but I probably wouldn’t buy it again.

avis.titre: Crappy product, doesn't even do what's advertised.
avis.texte: I had very severe cystic acne throughout my puberty, I'm still dealing with the aftermath of it years later, I'm now 20 years old and I of course like any other young person get fooled by advertising online, this is one of them, not only does this not remove blackheads, but it also does... you guessed it, absolutely nothing. It doesn't make your skin smoother, it doesn't remove blackheads, it does exactly that, nothing. If anything it just felt nice removing it ( a bit painful too ) and having your skin be smooth for like an hour, but thats about the extent of it. I might have some hard blackheads, who knows I'm not a dermatologist, but the product doesn't do as advertised. The substance is slimy, and cold, you can use the little spatula that it comes with, but you're still gonna make a mess because of how slimy the substance is. It's somewhat hard to get off your skin if you touch it, you have to scrub with water for about 40 seconds. But yea uh don't buy this crap, it does nothing. If anyone is telling you otherwise because, oh I tried it my skin was so nice after using it, it's because they probably don't have bad blackheads or just use this for no reason.

I bought it for my son, because he does not like black spots on his nose and is incredibly delighted, he applies it as often as necessary, does not cause irritation, is easy to apply and follows the recommended steps.

Genuinely impressed. This product managed to make my face that looked clean already, significantly cleaner and even soft after use. It's better to use after taking a nice warm or hot shower. Im definitely going to be a recurring customer here after finishing my first order. ❤️

avis.auteur: The lighter overall is a good lighter bu
avis.texte: Product works as advertised I notable see a difference in my nose area were the blackheads are and the rest of my skin comes out smooth and noticed it tightings the skin very well helks with forehead wrinkles.

avis.titre: Kein Fake, tiefenreine Haut, es funktioniert
avis.texte: Ich habe diese Aktivkohle-Masken ja eigentlich immer nur für einen TikTok-Fake gehalten, wollte es aufgrund der vielen positiven Bewertungen aber einfach mal ausprobieren. Das Ergebnis: Kein Fake, tiefenreine Haut, es funktioniert. Nur einen wichtigen Hinweis: Frauen mit feinem Gesichtshaar oder Männer mit Drei-Tage-Bart sollten aufpassen, denn diese Maske krallt sich nicht nur an jeder Hautunreinheit fest und zieht sie heraus - das macht sie auch mit Haaren :-) Lieferung von Amazon wie immer schnell und problemlos.
Muy buen producto, es la primera vez que lo utilizo y es efectivo para quitar los puntos negros del rostro.
WILL PEEL YOUR SKIN OFF kinda of kidding but seriously, it hurts to peel off so watch for how long you have it on for. Gets the job done though!

Make sure to let it dry all the way. Otherwise than that my children and I had a good time seeing who had the most black heads. It leaves your skin so soft and peeled off in large pieces. will need to buy this again soon.

i’m only docking one star off because peeling this face mask off was like peeling my own skin off. the mask dries really well (i did a thin coat) and works amazing! the peeling part was the W O R S T! it made both my eyes water and i had to stop and take a break. the smell isn’t the worst and my skin feels very dry after but i did cleanse before and after and then used moisturizer. If you don’t mind the pain, this mask does indeed work.

This product REALLY works. It pulled out 95% of everything out of my pores. It got all my blackheads, and peach fuzz off as well (which is sounding I wanted) and left my skin feeling SO smooth. If you don’t want to peel off a certain spot on your face, it comes off very easy with a wash cloth and warm water. It dries fast, doesn’t leave any sort of staining on your skin either. When applying, it leaves a cool refreshing feeling on your skin. The ONLY thing I could say, is my skin felt a bit dehydrated afterwards, but that is to be expected with a peel off, and nothing some face cream can’t fix. If you are looking for a great black head peel off mask, I highly recommend this one.

The main reason I got this was to remove the blackheads that have been on my nose for a long time. Unfortunately, it wasn't able to do that. It cleaned out some dead skin and removed the oils which is nice, but that's not exactly what I wanted it for. I took all the advice from the other reviews, putting more on and waiting a longer time. However the half dozen times I've used it I've gotten the same results no matter what I changed. I even got my girlfriend to try it and it had similar results with her. So for the price it really isn't that bad as a cleansing mask, especially with how much you get. But at least for me it didn't work at removing any blackheads.

I washed my face first, and let a warm cloth sit for a few minutes as the instructions said. It didn’t say to wash my face but I did anyway to make sure my pores were opened up. I applied a good amount like it said, I tried not to apply too much. I waited 50min for the mask to fully dry. There was still a wet spot when I took the mask off. I’ll try again with a smaller layer. When I peeled off the mask my face was super dry and some dead skin was coming off but it didn’t remove a single black head. I will try again with a thinner layer but so far I’m not satisfied with this product.

Why did you pick this product vs others?: My store got rid of the pore mask I used to use so read a couple of reviews and I am so amazed with this product. The little applicator that comes with it is better than my rubber one. Only had to use a small amount of product and it was dry within 10 minutes! The smell isn't bad just smells like the rest of them I have tried.
This can really clean out your pores and make your face look and feel so fresh!
The face mask works great! My only negative is that the spatula is so tiny it makes it difficult and time-consuming to properly apply the face mask. Other than that it works really good on my skin.

Peel off black mask dries within 12-15 minutes and ready to remove. Product doesn’t smell any bad or good. Product did NOT remove any blackheads nor whiteheads . All it removes is a bunch of tiny facial hair. Doesn’t worth apply on your skin.

avis.titre: The only thing it clears up is your bank account
avis.texte: It did nothing for my son’s blackheads. The strips are better and cost way less…. I’m so disappointed. We did exactly how the instructions directed us. The only thing that pulled off were probably some dead skin cells.

avis.titre: Not safe at all... got burns on my nose....
avis.texte: Please don't buy it unless you want burns on your face... Followed every single instruction but now can't leave the house...

My 13 year old son has been breaking out very badly. He is active in sports and sweats a lot! Using this product has greatly helped - it is a noticeable difference and he even stated his skin feels better! I would recommend!

I loved this . I used it once so far and my face is so soft. I did a thin layer but not thin enough that everything wasn't covered. It was on for 25 minutes. It peeled off really easy except for the really thin places around my eyes and hairline. (That's normal for any product I feel.) I used a hot washcloth for those parts and it was very simple. I can't wait to do it again.
Husband loves! He was needing a product to help with his black heads. This one works great and smells nice.
The one on the right is the older one it says it has the same amount in it but it doesn't. I actually love this product it's just a shame it's getting more and more pricey for less product

I noticed that it has a very pleasant smell, and is very easy to apply. I felt my skin tingling after it was first applied, then after about 10 minutes I could feel it drying and tightening on my face. After 30 minutes, it was completely dry and I peeled the whole thing off in one piece. When I inspected it, I saw all of nasty and disgusting things that were clogging my pores... My conclusion is that it works exactly as described and I will be purchasing it again.
Simply working good so far, my pores are already mostly clean, but this has helped me get some of the blackheads that form right at the base inside of my nose.
It's very good product, it takes out the black heads very well, makes the skin shine and smooth, it really works, highly recommend this product
My Brother in-law used the entire Jar on his back. Bro's back is cooked 🤣 it works but the aftermath was funny. He says he'll be buying 5 more jars if it works.
nice smell, skin softening , Great peeling and cleanser quality, good effectiveness
